items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was on that tour that Elvin met Keiko.

ctx.x: Well, did Tony get out and go back with you. Did he have to stay in Japan?

Tony stayed in Japan for six months in jail. Elvin stayed for quite sometime in jail. It was on that tour that Elvin met Keiko. She was on the train, and everybody said—Art Blakey said, “Man, you better leave that bitch alone. She’s probably the cops.” It wound up that he got together with Keiko. So, when he got busted, they had a picture of him coming out of the hotel with her on his arm, being arrested for narcotics. He didn’t have any narcotics. I mean, he may have had reefer, but I don’t think he had any. I…
When did you go to Europe?
